description: We are looking for a highly analytical and proactive Product Analyst to partner closely with Product Managers across our payments business. This role goes beyond data extraction, you will translate data into actionable insights, proactively monitor product performance, and help shape product decisions that drive growth. What You’ll Do 1. Product Analytics & Insights ● Analyze large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights for product teams ● Translate business questions into analytical frameworks and measurable metrics ● Identify opportunities to improve conversion, success rates, and user experience 2. Metrics Ownership & Monitoring ● Define, track, and monitor key product KPIs (e.g., payment success rates, drop-offs, latency, adoption) ● Build dashboards and automated reports to provide real-time visibility to stakeholders ● Proactively flag anomalies, performance drops, and emerging trends 3. Partner with Product & Engineering ● Work closely with Product Managers to evaluate new features, experiments, and product changes ● Support planning, testing, and post-launch analysis of product initiatives ● Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data availability and accuracy 4. Experimentation & Decision Support ● Design and analyze A/B tests and experiments ● Provide data-backed recommendations for product strategy and prioritization ● Evaluate impact of product changes and suggest next steps 5. Data Modeling & Deep Dives ● Perform deep-dive analyses on funnels, cohorts, and user behavior ● Build scalable SQL queries and data models for repeatable insights ● Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions What We’re Looking For Experience ● 1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst / Product Analyst / Data Analyst ● Experience in fintech/payments is a plus, not mandatory Core Skills ● Strong SQL skills (must-have), ability to work with large datasets independently ● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail ● Experience with Excel / Google Sheets; familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.) is a plus ● Ability to convert data into clear, actionable insights Mindset ● Proactive: doesn’t wait for asks, identifies problems/opportunities independently ● Curious: digs deep into “why” behind the numbers ● Structured thinker: can break down ambiguous problems into measurable components ● Good stakeholder communication skills Good to Have ● Experience working with payment systems (cards, UPI, etc.) ● Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing) ● Basic knowledge of Python/R for data analysis Why This Role Matters This role sits at the intersection of product, data, and business impact. You will directly influence product decisions by: ● Improving conversion and success rates ● Identifying growth opportunities ● Enabling faster, data-driven decision making Success in This Role Looks Like ● You proactively surface insights before PMs ask ● You become the go-to person for product metrics ● Your analysis directly influences roadmap and prioritization ● You help teams move from “data reporting” → “decision making”
title: Product Analyst- Payments

description: Always wanted to build an app used by millions? As part of this graduate Program you'll own part of the Picnic app from day one. You'll be end to end responsible for creating features by understanding our customers, analyzing data, working with business teams, sketching screens with designers, building with developers, and testing with analysts. You're the one making it all happen. This program at Picnic is one of the most ambitious tracks in the industry: from recent graduate to Product Manager. What You'll Be Doing Over two years you'll learn everything it takes to build a great product by actually doing it. You'll work alongside experienced product managers in our team. In time, you'll have the opportunity to change product scope to get well rounded experience in a different area as well. 0-6 months You learn how to solve customer problems. From day one, you’ll help build features used by millions of users, while getting to know our product end to end. To understand what to build, you’ll analyze customer behaviour through data analysis and interviews. Based on your learnings you’ll help shape new features. 6-12 months You build your first features from scratch. This is the first time you'll own the full product development lifecycle. With help of an experienced Product Manager, you’ll scope a customer problem, shape the solution across design, engineering, data, and business. You’ll drive execution on your plan, ship to customers & see the direct impact of your work. 12+ months You own a product scope end to end. You decide what problems to solve and own the solutions: the research, the analyses, the designs, the stakeholders, the tech. You are in the lead and responsible for the outcome. The Program The launchpad to Product Manager. Learn everything there is about building product & become a PM twice as fast as the industry standard. Ownership from day one. You'll immediately work on the Picnic app, alongside our experienced product team. You’ll get to experience different scopes ranging from Home page to Payments, Search to Personalisation. Tangible impact: Every feature you ship is measured, so you'll see the exact impact of your decisions in real data. If it works, double down. If it doesn't, own it and iterate. Mentorship: You'll have a dedicated mentor accelerating your growth. But most of what you learn, you learn by actually doing it. Who Are You We’re looking for future leaders who are hungry to learn, eager to build, and passionate about our mission. You don’t need years of product management experience, but you do need to show us you have the raw talent and drive to succeed. Master's degree in a quantitative field like Econometrics, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar. Recent graduate or up to two years of professional experience. Builder at heart. You've taken initiative and created something from scratch, whether that's a side project, a new idea, or your own startup. Highly ambitious, natural curiosity and empathy for users. You want to understand, you're always asking "why", and you always think about how to make things better. Go-getter personality. You're biased toward action and constantly pushing toward clarity and delivery. Many strong candidates talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this role excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. This vacancy remains open, we hire throughout the year whenever we find the right match. Why Picnic? Invent the future: We’re not just improving an industry; we’re rebuilding it from scratch. You'll work on challenges no one has solved before. Hands-on from day one: We believe in doing, not just theorizing. You'll get your hands dirty, build real things, and see your impact immediately. Learn by doing, together: We do, we fail, we learn. You'll work side-by-side with top-notch colleagues who will challenge and support you every day. A sustainable mission: Join a company committed to making the world a better place, one electric vehicle at a time. Have fun along the way: We celebrate our successes with legendary parties, team events, and free daily lunches. Ready to build the future with us? Apply now and tell us what you would build first. Picnic Perks 🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up. 🚲Health insurance discount & bike plan We have a partnership with CZ (a health insurance provider). Picnic employees get a discount on CZ insurance packages between 5% and 15%. Furthermore, through our partnership with Lease a Bike, you can rent-to-own a new (e)bike at a discounted rate 🗺️Relocation If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs for you and your partner and kids, your first month's rent and moving costs (up to €2000), and help you with the 30% tax ruling setup and application. 🍎Learning & development You’ll get ample opportunity to work on yourself at Picnic. We offer personal development through Lepaya courses, Academy trainings, and more. Interested in improving your mental wellbeing? Through OpenUp you get free access to trained psychologists and many courses. ⛳All the rest At Picnic you get 25 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, as well. https://youtube.com/embed/4tUXuCli4LE

description: About Centric Software Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market. Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional. Strategic Growth Marketing Manager - EMEA Retail Job Title: Strategic Growth Marketing Manager – EMEA Retail Location: Germany, France, the United Kingdom (100% Remote) Contract: Full Time Centric Software, a fast-growing, innovation-driven enterprise software company, is seeking a Strategic Growth Marketing Manager to accelerate growth across strategic Retail markets in Europe. Initially focused on Grocery and Multi-Category Retail (MCR), this role will define and execute growth strategies for priority markets by combining Account-Based Marketing (ABM), targeted demand generation, thought leadership and executive engagement. Reporting directly to the EMEA Marketing Director , you will act as the strategic marketing lead for these industries, working closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content Marketing, Field Marketing, Marketing Channel Performance Managers and external agencies to drive pipeline growth across Europe. Over time, the scope of the role will expand to additional strategic industries including Food & Beverage, Cosmetics & Personal Care and Fashion, leveraging proven methodologies and best practices developed within the Retail segment. This is a 100% remote position based in EMEA, preferably in Germany, France or the United Kingdom. You have strong Account-Based Marketing expertise, experience working with enterprise sales organizations, and a passion for developing growth strategies for complex B2B software markets. If you enjoy building strategic marketing programs, influencing cross-functional teams and working with some of the world's leading retailers, we'd love to hear from you. Key Responsibilities Define and execute strategic growth plans Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for strategic Retail industries across Europe, initially Grocery and Multi-Category Retail. Identify market opportunities, customer challenges, competitive positioning and commercial priorities. Translate business objectives into measurable marketing plans aligned with regional sales priorities. Lead Account-Based Marketing initiatives Own the ABM strategy for strategic European accounts. Coordinate external ABM agencies to execute personalized account engagement programs. Work closely with Sales to define target account strategies, buying committees and engagement plans. Monitor account engagement and marketing contribution to pipeline. Drive thought leadership and content strategy Define content priorities supporting strategic industries and ABM programs. Coordinate the development of executive content, customer stories, webinars, guides, industry reports... Partner closely with Product Marketing and Field Marketing to ensure consistent messaging and market relevance. Support targeted demand generation Design nurturing programs supporting strategic markets and target accounts. Ensure campaigns are aligned with buyer personas, account maturity and commercial priorities. Coordinate with Marketing Channel Performance Managers to deliver high-performing multi-channel campaigns. Deliver strategic market engagement Identify and coordinate a limited number of high-value industry events, executive roundtables and customer engagement initiatives across Europe. Maximize account engagement before, during and after strategic events. Develop scalable marketing playbooks Capture learnings and best practices from Retail marketing initiatives. Develop repeatable ABM, campaign and content frameworks that can be leveraged across EMEA. Support the progressive expansion of these approaches into additional strategic industries including Food & Beverage, Cosmetics & Personal Care and Fashion. Success Measures Success Will Be Measured Through Marketing contribution to qualified pipeline from strategic industries. Engagement and progression of target accounts. Performance of Account-Based Marketing programs against defined objectives. Delivery of integrated marketing programs supporting commercial priorities. Successful execution of strategic events and market initiatives. Effective collaboration with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders. Requirements 5–8 years of experience in B2B Enterprise Marketing, with a strong focus on strategic marketing or field marketing. Proven experience developing and executing Account-Based Marketing programs targeting enterprise accounts. Experience working closely with enterprise Sales organizations. Experience coordinating external agencies and cross-functional marketing teams. Strong strategic thinking combined with excellent execution capabilities. Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced international environment. Experience with Salesforce, Pardot (or equivalent marketing automation platform), LinkedIn Campaign Manager and marketing analytics. Willingness to travel for strategic events and customer engagements. Fluent English required. Additional European languages are a plus. Additional Information This is a home-office-based position. You must be comfortable working remotely and have a designated home office space with a reliable internet connection. Depending on the country and city of residence, offices or coworking spaces are available. Occasional travel is required to support strategic customer engagements, executive events and regional marketing initiatives. description: Job Description TRANSACTION BANKING We aim to build a modern and digital-first transaction banking solution to serve our clients. Our business combines the strength, heritage, and expertise of a 150-year-old firm with the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of a tech start-up. Our goal is to provide a best-in-class digital product that helps clients to succeed by giving them a holistic view of their business. Through the use of modern technology built on the cloud, we are the alternative to legacy platforms. We’re a team of diverse experts helping our clients to build the future of their Treasury. Billing Product Manager Associate The Billing Product team drives the strategy and optimization of billing capabilities. This role is responsible for managing and evolving scalable, well-governed end-to-end billing capabilities, delivering meaningful impact for clients and internal stakeholders. Key responsibilities include enabling new commercial billing strategies and ensuring robust controls and governance. Candidates must have experience in the financial services or banking industry. Strong knowledge of billing, payments, channels, or transaction banking is highly preferred. You will partner closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations) to deliver client-centric capabilities that meet commercial and regulatory requirements. Responsibilities Roadmap Execution: Define and execute a product roadmap for scalable and automated billing capabilities. Strategy Formulation: Assess client & user needs, market trends, and competitive disruptions to identify opportunities and shape the billing product strategy. Agile Delivery: Lead and participate in Agile ceremonies to establish team cadence, promote transparency, and drive iterative delivery. Lifecycle Management: Own end-to-end delivery for key offerings (business case, requirements, testing, go-to-market, commercialization, and ongoing lifecycle management). Performance Tracking: Define, track, and report product performance metrics (KPIs) and adoption to inform prioritization and investment decisions. Data-Driven Insights: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to uncover trends, validate hypotheses, and continuously improve the roadmap. Stakeholder Enablement: Enable Sales, Implementation, and Service teams by communicating product capabilities and supporting go-to-market execution. Risk Management: Identify and manage product, operational, and technology risks in partnership with second and third lines of defense. Collaboration: Build strong relationships across business, product, and technology teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver outcomes. The Ideal Candidate Has Experience in billing, commercial governance, or product management within transaction banking or payments. Proven ability to translate business strategy and analysis into product requirements and deliverable features. Working knowledge of transaction banking concepts such as billing, transaction monitoring, payment rails, and digital/API channels. Excellent organizational, time management, and planning skills. Experience working in Agile product delivery environments. Exceptional communication skills, including comfort presenting to senior leaders and influencing decision-making. Ability to operate strategically and tactically, prioritizing in ambiguity while driving detailed, iterative execution toward a long-term vision. Collaborative approach with the ability to navigate complexity and influence across teams. Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, and Risk to meet regulatory requirements for billing, client communications, and product controls. Strong risk mindset and understanding of building products in a regulated environment. Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment and supporting growth across teams and product scope. Mission-driven and motivated by building modern, digital-first transaction banking products. Commitment to an inclusive culture and designing for a diverse client base. Forward-thinking, with an ability to anticipate organizational needs and drive operational efficiency. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree or military experience. 3–5 years of experience in product management, billing, or related roles (e.g., corporate payments, treasury management, operations, or software delivery) within financial services. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Finance, Economics, or Engineering. MBA or Master’s degree. Experience in a banking or financial services organization. Experience translating client and business needs into product strategy, requirements, and delivered capabilities.

They are committed to let the customers discover the joy of creating and building spaces that mirror who they are. About the role: We’re looking for a sharp, data-driven Online & Marketplace Revenue Leader to own and scale the brand's online business. This role carries full revenue and P&L ownership, with a clear mandate to build scale, profitability, and long-term growth. The role blends strategy and execution, requiring strong judgment across growth levers, consumer journeys, remarketing, and partnerships. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy building businesses from scratch, and use data to drive decisive action, this role offers a high-impact opportunity. Roles and Responsibilities: Revenue Ownership & P&L - Own online revenue, growth targets, and P&L across D2C and marketplace channels. Drive sustainable growth across new and repeat users with a strong focus on contribution margins and LTV. D2C Growth & Optimization - Improve and scale the existing D2C business by strengthening acquisition efficiency, conversion rates, retention, and repeat revenue. Identify and unlock growth levers across pricing, promotions, UX, merchandising, and lifecycle marketing. Remarketing & Retention - Lead remarketing initiatives across SMS, WhatsApp, email, and other lifecycle channels to improve engagement, repeat rate, and LTV. Build consumer cohorts across the journey and drive monetisation through personalised communication. Funnel & Conversion Excellence - Strengthen funnel metrics including PPV, ATC, conversion rate, repeat rate, and LTV. Drive conversion improvements through offers, discounts, and experience-led interventions. Data, Analytics & Consumer Journey - Own attribution and measurement across channels and touchpoints. Leverage data to drive decisions on pricing, product placement, merchandising, and promotions. Use insights from analytics platforms, to optimize the end-to-end consumer journey. Team & Stakeholder Leadership - Build and lead a high-performing D2C and marketplace team. Manage internal teams, agencies, and partners with clear goals and accountability. Collaborate closely with brand, product, tech, supply chain, finance,and CX teams. Desired Skills and Functional Experience: Experience: 6-10 years of experience in growth and revenue leadership within a D2C brand. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. A master’s degree is a plus. Revenue & P&L Ownership: Demonstrated ownership of revenue targets and profitability. Digital & Growth Skills: Strong command of performance marketing, remarketing channels, and growth funnels. Analytics & Tech: Experience with platforms, MMPs, CDPs, GA, PowerBI, CleverTap, or similar tools. Leadership: Strong people leadership and team-building experience. Strategic & Analytical Thinking: Ability to translate data into business action. Execution Orientation: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, outcome-driven environments. Backed by Busybeebrands.com, a pioneering brand-building firm that has helped some of the most disruptive new-age brands in the country craft their brand and marketing strategy, we find opportunities with progressives startups and brands in the domain of marketing with multiple engagement models for our talent partners, freelance / part-time or full-time.
